data.one_liner: Desktop WebView plugin for Windows and Linux implementing the webview_flutter interface.
data.what_it_does: Provides native WebView rendering on Windows and Linux using the webview_flutter API. It places a native WebView directly on top of the Flutter window for high-performance video playback and scrolling.
use_when: You need native WebView rendering on Windows or Linux.
You want to reuse familiar webview_flutter API code for desktop platforms.
You need smooth video playback and high-performance scrolling inside a desktop WebView.
avoid_when: You need Flutter widgets to render above the WebView.
You need to push a new route above the WebView.
You require automatic clipping of the WebView inside scrollable widgets without manual handling.
strengths: Reuses the webview_flutter API interface for desktop platforms.
Native WebView rendering provides high-performance video playback and scrolling on Windows and Linux.
Supports custom user data folders and isolated profiles (Windows only).
weaknesses: Flutter widgets cannot render above the WebView because it places a native view directly on top.
Cannot push a new route above the WebView.
Flutter cannot clip the WebView, so it may remain visible outside its parent area.
data.setup_notes: Add webview_win_floating and webview_flutter to pubspec.yaml. Linux platform may require build-time considerations documented in README_Linux.md.
